Historical full-card image of [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court) (PC Errata 2007)|Tusken Breath Mask]] ([[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]]). Its game text matches the Players Committee's errata sheet of 17 September 2007 (“…may add X to your total ability during battle at a site.”), not the re-issued set sheet, which prints “…your total ability during battle at a site is +X.” It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
